checked.text: Archive keeper: ‘Now someone else can try what we did—and disagree with the result. Bring that habit to the next debate; leave the pots here.’
Debate host: ‘We have not chosen a tax. We have learned why a sound inference can carry an unsound premise. Now the library needs that same care with words.’
Editor: ‘We have not made disagreement disappear. We have made the readings and our choices inspectable. The next collection asks whether an unknown number can be handled with the same openness.’

Printer: ‘The same page can be made in different ways, and a changed order can favor a different tool. The next gallery asks why an apparently simple apparatus behaves differently when something changes.’

Electricity-gallery curator: ‘The quiet intervals mattered as much as the moving needle. Our exhibit now explains where the lamp’s energy comes from. In the next collection, the question is different: how can an agreed signal survive noise?’
